title: Compile-time resource nodes now yield the catalog item, not the resource-kind string
summary: WorldCompiler set ResourceNodeState.yields_item from the module resource kind (herb_patch), so herb harvesting never completed. Resolver now records the catalog yield item on ResolvedResourceProfile; compiler consumes it (ResourceRegistry fallback). ItemRegistry misses 104/72/0 -> 0/0/0; herb harvested 0 -> 5 in both affected worlds. wood/iron fixed statically. One slow SimQ anchor moves (named, re-baseline deferred).

title: Unknown-item interaction rejections recorded via the authoritative rejection audit
summary: Option 3 (user-approved): kept the non-fatal None on the apply path and added a loud diagnostic at the consuming call site (InteractionSystem.enforce) using rejections_delta plus a typed RejectionEvent (ReasonCode.UNKNOWN_ITEM); capacity failures are not reported as unknown. Call-site governance documented. Post-fix misses are 0.

title: Semantic Control Plane epic closed: M0-M4 proof of generalization delivered, programme continues
summary: All M0-M4 milestone rows carry a disposition; epic closes the bounded proof, not the programme (rollout Stages D/E/F and M3 continue). Compass section 10 weakness kept open for an owner decision; regional-sovereignty threshold ticket cross-referenced (itself since done).
